sources.description: Terrain pieces, coast under-layers and optional grid: authoring/shared/painters/terrain.py with parameters in authoring/campaign-atlas-01/batch.json. Land pieces and coast layers are raster-masked and have no vector master; the sea tiles and grid do. Drawn by an AI model as Python drawing code (pycairo 1.25 / cairo 1.18, Pillow 12.3, numpy 2.5) under authoring/; no image-generation model and no external image was used as input. Rebuild with: python authoring/build.py authoring/campaign-atlas-01.

sources.description: French line fusilier, Old Guard grenadier and chasseur à cheval, September 1805: rigs in authoring/shared/painters (figure, infantry, cavalry), uniforms in authoring/campaign-atlas-01/units/france-1805.json, drills in musket-drill.json and sabre-charge.json. References were read for facts of dress only; no plate or photograph was copied. Uniform research and legibility adjustments are recorded in design/art/units.md. No vector master: the editable source is the rig and its data. Drawn by an AI model as Python drawing code (pycairo 1.25 / cairo 1.18, Pillow 12.3, numpy 2.5) under authoring/; no image-generation model and no external image was used as input. Rebuild with: python authoring/build.py authoring/campaign-atlas-01.

sources.description: Napoléon, autumn 1805: original half-length drawing in authoring/campaign-atlas-01/portraits/napoleon/illustration.py; the avatar is the same drawing rendered through the crop box in character.json.
